protocol.selection: Start with the original single-function Alive2 miscompilation pool. Exclude its prior repair exclusions and all bugs screened in the original fresh archive. Sort the remaining pool by reproducer lines and numeric ID into equal-sized tiers. Within each tier sort by SHA-256 of protocol ID + colon + bug ID and round-robin components. Take the first six eligible per tier, skipping duplicate witness hashes within the new cohort and against the original fresh archive.

comparison.endpoint: paired minus focused LLVM fraction of original instructions removed after independent postcheck
comparison.test: two-sided exact paired sign test at the primary budget; other budgets descriptive
